textLabel: Type your diagram, one step per line
textHint: Write each step as Name->Name: text. Up to 10 names and 60 steps. For a phone video, 3 to 5 names read best.
syntax: Syntax guide: everything you can write
syntaxHint: Tap Add to put a line in your diagram.
arrowsHint: Turn this off to show only the text moving between names, with no arrow lines. Useful when you explain it in your own voice.
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
voiceHint: Record your voice while you tap through the steps, so the picture follows what you say. Or add an audio file you already have. Your voice stays on your device.
voiceTapTitle: Recording: say it, then tap Next step
voiceReady: Tap Next step each time you move to the next point. Nothing shows before your first tap.
voiceBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow the microphone for this page, or add an audio file instead.
voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone. Add an audio file instead.
voiceReadFailed: That audio could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
voiceTimed: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps follow the moments you tapped.
voiceFitted: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps are spread to fit it.
voiceChanged: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. You changed the number of steps after recording, so the steps are spread to fit the voice.
voiceFit: Spread the steps to fit the voice
voiceNoSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video. The video will be made without it. You can add your voice in your editing app.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
empty: Write a first step above, for example: Customer->Shop: Place order
scrollNote: This diagram is taller than the picture, so the view moves down as the steps appear.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot. If you added your voice here, the sound is already in the file.
credit: The diagram text uses the WebSequenceDiagrams style, so many existing diagrams can be pasted in. Includes, references and parallel blocks are not supported.

syntaxItems.title: Arrow
syntaxItems.note: Name, arrow, name, then a colon and the text. Names are made the first time you use them.

syntaxItems.title: Open arrow head
syntaxItems.note: Two > signs give an open head.

syntaxItems.title: Dotted arrow
syntaxItems.note: Two dashes give a dotted line, often used for a reply.
syntaxItems.code:
A-->B: Dotted
A-->>B: Dotted, open head

syntaxItems.title: Slow arrow
syntaxItems.note: A number in brackets slants the arrow down, to show it takes time.

syntaxItems.title: Arrow to itself
syntaxItems.note: The same name on both sides.

syntaxItems.title: From or to outside
syntaxItems.note: A bracket on one side starts or ends the arrow at the edge of the picture.

syntaxItems.title: Names, order and shapes
syntaxItems.note: Declare a name to set the order, give a long name a short one with as, or pick a shape: actor, database, cloud, queue or collections.
syntaxItems.code:
participant:actor User
participant:database "Order store" as DB

syntaxItems.title: New line in text
syntaxItems.note: Type \n where the text should break.

syntaxItems.title: Notes
syntaxItems.note: Beside a name or over one or two names. Use a note with several lines and end note for long text.
syntaxItems.code:
note left of A: Left
note right of A: Right
note over A: Over
note over A, B: Over two

syntaxItems.title: Note with several lines
syntaxItems.code:
note over A
Line one
Line two
end note

syntaxItems.title: State
syntaxItems.note: A rounded box on a name, for a status.

syntaxItems.title: Boxes around steps
syntaxItems.note: alt, opt, loop, par, seq, break and group. Each ends with end. Add else inside alt for the other case. Boxes can sit inside each other.
syntaxItems.code:
alt it works
  A->B: Yes
else it fails
  A->B: No
end

syntaxItems.title: Active bars
syntaxItems.note: A + after the arrow starts a bar on the receiver, a - ends the sender's bar. You can also write activate and deactivate.

syntaxItems.title: Create and destroy
syntaxItems.note: A star creates the receiver at that point. destroy ends its line with a cross.

syntaxItems.title: Divider and delay
syntaxItems.note: A double line with text, and a gap with text.

syntaxItems.title: Pause (video only)
syntaxItems.note: Holds the picture for the seconds you write, from 0.5 to 10. Nothing is drawn. Useful while you are speaking.

syntaxItems.title: Title, numbers and comments
syntaxItems.note: A title shows at the top, autonumber adds a number to every arrow, and a line starting with # is ignored.
syntaxItems.code:
title My diagram
autonumber
# This line is a comment
